# Zero Release Checklist

The CI already builds the four target binaries and publishes them as release assets (see
`.github/workflows/release.yml`). This checklist covers the human-verified parts.

## Pre-release

- [ ] `zig fmt --check src examples` is clean.
- [ ] `zig build test`, `zig build test-integration`, `zig build test-validation` are green on the commit to be tagged.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the new version with date and notable changes.
- [ ] `build.zig.zon` `version` field matches the release tag (tags are `vX.Y.Z`).
- [ ] Public API surface in `docs/PUBLIC_API.md` still matches `src/zero.zig`
      (no undocumented breaking change slipped in).
- [ ] SBOM job in `.github/workflows/release.yml` produced `final-sbom.json`
      and it is attached to the release (see SECURITY.md).

## Tagging and building

- [ ] Tag the commit: `git tag vX.Y.Z && git push origin vX.Y.Z`.
- [ ] Wait for the `Release` workflow to finish on both Linux targets
      (x86_64-linux, aarch64-linux).
- [ ] Verify each asset sha256 matches the `*.sha256` files in the release.

## Signing and publishing

- [ ] Download the two `zero-*.tar.gz` assets and their `.sha256` files.
- [ ] Produce detached signatures: `gpg -u <key> --detach-sign zero-<target>.tar.gz`.
- [ ] Upload the `.asc` signatures as release assets alongside the binaries.
- [ ] Confirm `final-sbom.json` (generated by the `sbom` job) is attached.
- [ ] Publish the GitHub Release (auto-generated release notes are acceptable).

## Post-release

- [ ] Announce in the project's release channel.
- [ ] Close the milestone / tracking issue for the version.
- [ ] If this is a security release, notify the SECURITY.md disclosure list first.
